senses.gloss_en: patron (financial supporter of arts and sciences)
megaphone (portable, usually hand-held, funnel-shaped device that is used to amplify a person’s natural voice toward a targeted direction)
highlight (a strand or spot of hair dyed a different color than the rest)
meningeal (of or relating to the meninges)
meniscus (either of two parts of the human knee that provide structural integrity to the knee when it undergoes tension and torsion)
specific (being per unit mass, volume, etc.)
lunar (of, or pertaining to, the moon)
mass (related to the ceremony of Holy Communion)
metamorphosis (a fundamental transformation of character or appearance)
entresol (an intermediate floor in a building)
intergovernmental (of, relating to, or involving two or more governments)
